sources.NAME: keremberke/football-object-detection
sources.LICENSE_VERIFIED_FROM: README.md dataset card + README.dataset.txt in the export
sources.DOMAIN: Euro 2020 broadcast, wide tactical, beIN/RaiPlay feeds, 1280x720, no resize applied
sources.PARTIAL_ANNOTATION_RISK: CLASS COLLAPSE, not missing labels: officials and goalkeepers ARE annotated, but as "player" (verified visually on yellow-kit officials)

sources.NAME: Voxel51/SoccerNet-V3
sources.DOMAIN: real broadcast, 55 matches, 6 European leagues, 3 seasons, 1280x720 and 1920x1080
sources.PARTIAL_ANNOTATION_RISK: LOW for the four EyeCU classes; the export also carries Staff members, Wall of players, Referee flag and cards, which must be dropped, not mapped
sources.DUPLICATE_RISK: action frame + up to 8 replay frames per event; replays are of the SAME action and are correlated by construction
sources.NEXT_ALLOWED_ACTION: label-quality and duplicate audit on the downloaded payload, then Experiment D candidacy
sources.NOTES: The only audited source with goalkeeper AND referee as distinct classes at scale, and the only one with real multi-league diversity. Ball median 35.45 px at 1920-equivalent, 4 balls <=8 px.
